_note: Inkborne glossary. status canon = from Lisa's CANON.md, SPEC section 2, or Kekai-approved Ollie item text; TBD = not yet confirmed (none left). Item names and ids follow Ollie's list per Kekai; Systems numbers map onto those ids.

entries.name: Inkborne
entries.desc: Title of the game. SPEC v1.1 says "the title is back to Inkborne".

entries.name: Shirofuda
entries.desc: The world, painted into being by the First Brush; everything in it is ink on living paper.

entries.name: First Brush
entries.desc: The brush that painted Shirofuda. Each party member carries a fragment of its red ink.

entries.name: the Blot
entries.desc: A creeping smear soaking through cracked seals, unwriting what it touches into blank paper and ink-beasts.

entries.name: red seals
entries.desc: Seals of the old shrines that keep the painting true. They are cracking.

entries.name: Hanshi
entries.desc: Border town of paper-walled houses and red lanterns, named for calligraphy paper. World node and POI `town`.

entries.name: Sumikage Wood
entries.desc: "Ink-shadow wood": bamboo, old pines, mist, and broken seal-stones along the path. World node and POI `forest`.

entries.name: Kōbō Tsuru
entries.desc: General store in Hanshi run by Grandmother Tsuru. Shop id `kobo_tsuru`.

entries.name: Grandmother Tsuru
entries.desc: Old shopkeeper of Kōbō Tsuru. Keeper id `tsuru`.

entries.name: Old Hotaru
entries.desc: Hanshi's lamplighter, a stooped, soft-spoken old man who relights the red lanterns every dusk and talks to each flame like a grandchild. First to notice the flames are greying.

entries.name: Itsuki Hane
entries.desc: Wandering Swordsman. Lead, physical. Calm, guarded, no memory before waking in Sumikage Wood with a blank seal on his palm. Gale ink.
entries.title: Wandering Swordsman

entries.name: Benika Matsuo
entries.desc: Shrine Archer. Healer and support. Bright, stubborn keeper of Hanshi's shrine. Ember ink.
entries.title: Shrine Archer

entries.name: Gonzō Kuraishi
entries.desc: Retired Temple Monk. Tank and heavy hitter. Gruff, kind, haunted by a seal he failed to protect. Stone ink.
entries.title: Retired Temple Monk

entries.name: Gale Crane
entries.desc: Itsuki's Inkwing: long white-and-grey crane wings, muted pale jade tint.

entries.name: Ember Kite
entries.desc: Benika's Inkwing: wide kite-bird wings smoldering at the tips, muted ochre tint, drifting ash.

entries.name: Stone Owl
entries.desc: Gonzō's Inkwing: heavy owl wings like layered slate, cracks glowing faintly red.

entries.name: Falling Pine
entries.desc: Itsuki's signature Stroke chain.

entries.name: Three Prayer Slips
entries.desc: Benika's signature Stroke chain.

entries.name: Temple Bell
entries.desc: Gonzō's signature Stroke chain.

entries.name: Wet Edge
entries.desc: Itsuki's second Stroke.

entries.name: Lantern Volley
entries.desc: Benika's second Stroke.

entries.name: Mountain Gong
entries.desc: Gonzō's second Stroke.

entries.name: Gale Crane Script
entries.desc: Itsuki's Seal Art while Unfurled.

entries.name: Ember Kite Litany
entries.desc: Benika's Seal Art while Unfurled.

entries.name: Stone Owl Verse
entries.desc: Gonzō's Seal Art while Unfurled.

entries.name: Blotling
entries.desc: A small puddle of living ink with one blinking eye. Splits when struck hard.
entries.flavor: A puddle that learned to look back at you.

entries.name: Hollow Lantern
entries.desc: A torn paper lantern on ink smoke, its red flame going grey. Casts a dimming curse that lowers accuracy.

entries.name: Smudge Ronin
entries.desc: Demo mini-boss. A samurai half-unwritten by the Blot, with a dripping blade and only a wet brushstroke for a face.
entries.flavor: Whoever he was, the Blot kept only the sword.

entries.name: Brushstroke
entries.desc: Timed multi-hit combo: press as the ring closes. Each press is a Stroke; named chains are also Strokes.

entries.name: Stroke
entries.desc: One press in a Brushstroke, or a character's named chain.

entries.name: Clean Line
entries.desc: Perfect press in a tight window: x1.25 hit damage and extra ink.

entries.name: Inkwing
entries.desc: Winged elemental form. Costs a full gauge, lasts 3 of that character's turns.

entries.name: Unfurl
entries.desc: The act and battle command that transforms a character into their Inkwing.

entries.name: Seal Arts
entries.desc: Timed magic while Unfurled: press as the brush passes each red seal.

entries.name: Still Water
entries.desc: Guard: halves damage taken and heals 10% HP.

entries.name: Six Inks
entries.desc: The elements: Ember/Tide, Gale/Stone, Dawn/Dusk. Opposites x2, same x0.5.

entries.name: mon
entries.desc: Currency.

entries.name: Vermilion Ink
entries.desc: Per-character 0-100 gauge filled by successful hits; a full gauge lets you Unfurl. UI key: battle.gauge.label.
entries.source: SPEC §2 (renamed by Kekai after IP review)

entries.name: Ember
entries.desc: One of the Six Inks.

entries.name: Tide
entries.desc: One of the Six Inks.

entries.name: Gale
entries.desc: One of the Six Inks.

entries.name: Stone
entries.desc: One of the Six Inks.

entries.name: Dawn
entries.desc: One of the Six Inks.

entries.name: Dusk
entries.desc: One of the Six Inks.

entries.name: Rice Cake
entries.desc: Sweet and filling. Restores a little HP to one ally.

entries.name: Plum Tonic
entries.desc: Sour enough to wake the dead, nearly. Restores a lot of HP to one ally.

entries.name: Pot of Pine Tea
entries.desc: One pot, three cups. Restores some HP to the whole party.

entries.name: Festival Bento
entries.desc: Packed for a feast that never came. Restores a lot of HP to the whole party.

entries.name: Inkstone Chip
entries.desc: Grind it, wet it, and the brush drinks. Restores a little ink.

entries.name: Pot of Fresh Ink
entries.desc: Rich and dark, still smelling of pine soot. Restores a lot of ink.

entries.name: Paper Firecracker
entries.desc: Festival leftovers. Bangs loudly enough to scatter a Blotling.

entries.name: Thunder Jar
entries.desc: Grandmother Tsuru won't say what's in it. Hits all enemies.
